result:
Both steps are committed and pushed to `develop`, and all the tests run plus the guard set passed (gate green).

- **Step 1, f8614268, `std: fs::canonical and Path.strip_prefix`:** programs can now call `p.strip_prefix(base)` and `fs::canonical(path, root)`. I also added `fs::Path::clone`, which the brief didn't ask for: `shown_path` failed to compile without it (NK1171, "`fs::Path` has no method called `clone`"), so I fixed it in `std` rather than working around it. The spec (Part III 17.1) and ADR-319 D3 are amended.
- **New test `fs_canonical`:** it covers `strip_prefix` results including the `null` cases, `clone`, canonical names shown relative to a scratch root, `NotFound`, and `Outside` for `..` and `x/../..`. It has no symlink row because `std::fs` offers no way to make a link; the commit message says so.
- **Step 2, 594cb42d, `project: shown_path into Nikaia`:** `shown_path` now lives in `project_tests.nika`. It isn't async, so `project.rs` calls it directly; where `fs::canonical` throws it falls back to the name as given, as the Rust did. `lower-std` reached its fixpoint, changing only `project_tests`' lowered file and one index line. The selfhosting-plan rows for P3a, P3b and P4 now record the `std::fs` prerequisite as met.

**Converter score is below the stop line:** `rs2nika --score` kept 0 of 4 lines, under the 60% at which the driver stops the pipeline until the converter is fixed. It doesn't map `canonicalize()` to `fs::canonical(..., fs::Root::Anywhere)`, `to_path_buf()` to `clone()`, or the `strip_prefix(..).map(..).unwrap_or_else(..)` chain to `??`.

- **Tests:** `tests/compiler` in both settings, 206 passed. `tests/language`, 404 passed, but that ran before I added `clone`. The `it` tests named in the brief plus the guard set, 51 passed. The `fs::` and `project::` unit tests passed. Clippy, fmt and `pre-push-check` are clean. The new test was not run against a compiler without the change: it is a new feature, not a fix.
- **For you:** step 1 changes `std`, so it needs a version raise. Suggested changelog line: "`std::fs` gains `fs::canonical(path, root)`, and `fs::Path` gains `strip_prefix` and `clone`."
- **Disk:** the test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is at 4.0 GB and 16 GB is free on `/`; nothing was freed. One new entry over 100 MB: `run-bundle/65d964130cc06fb2`, 300 MB.
